product_one_liner.value: Authentic8’s Silo Workspace gives intelligence, security and investigative teams an isolated cloud workspace to conduct anonymous online investigations, collect evidence and accelerate analysis with integrated AI.

employee_band.notes: Published counts of 124 and 127 both fall within this band.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index is focused on OSINT practice, security guidance and product content; no qualifying collection of engineer-authored product-building posts was found.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable job board lists Governance Administration Specialist and Sales Development Representative, Commercial; neither is a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.notes: No named underlying AI model or provider found in the Nexus AI product page and FAQ, public support documentation, launch blog, privacy policy or third-party processor list. Public descriptions refer only to external AI providers or public AI models.

compliance_certs.notes: These are the company’s public claims: its Platform Assurance page names all five under security and compliance certifications. Detailed wording distinguishes ISO certification and SOC assessment from HIPAA-compliant service, GDPR compliance support and PCI Security Standards Council participation; the latter claims do not establish independent certification.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Miguel Ramos started as Chief Product Officer in January 2026, following Head of Product. This is an internal appointment into the C-suite, not an external hire or departure.
